candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout ~2s), causing order and checkout to return 502; inventory/redis path is healthy.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show client-side ReadTimeout on payment; no payment-side latency metrics or logs to confirm the payment service itself is slow versus a network/transport issue.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ReadTimeout errors on POST payment in traces; inventory/redis reservations succeed. Payment-side telemetry is absent, so the bounded candidate is downstream latency at payment.
missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency/error metrics or logs to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Network/transport diagnostics between order and payment to rule out connectivity faults
